description.en: Original basic Cothurnocystis-inspired flattened asymmetric boot-shaped plated theca, with broad connected plate fields and one long curved segmented appendage naturally seated at its base. General group text and named captions do not establish species-exact plate seams or feeding mechanism; no starfish or stretched plated sphere.
